lesson.content:
### Understanding 1. Foundations & Environment Setup

In this lesson, we explore the fundamental mechanics, theoretical guarantees, and practical engineering applications of **1. Foundations & Environment Setup**.

#### Key Learning Objectives:
1. Core concepts, definitions, and mental models
2. Complexity analysis and asymptotic bounds
3. Common edge cases and defensive patterns
4. Real-world industry benchmarks and applications
